components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); padding: 0 0.625rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button for toolbars and dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); padding: 0 0.625rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact field for forms, filters, and toolbar search.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 2rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Structured Card
components.description: Flat content container with structural ring and compact padding.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); padding: 1rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.375; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-description { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: fit-content; height: 1.25rem; gap: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); padding: 0 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: Dense module navigation item with active and hover states.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; width: 100%; min-width: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; height: 2rem; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); padding: 0 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-sidebar-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-sidebar-item span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview: Synapse is a dense product interface for people managing local AI capabilities, editor integrations, Agent sessions, workflows, data, diagnostics, and usage. The system should feel like a precise workbench: organized surfaces, obvious controls, visible state, and no unnecessary spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Compact product density with 32px default controls.
Neutral surfaces, semantic state color, and chart color only where data needs it.
Familiar shadcn/Radix controls with consistent interactive states.
Layering through token backgrounds, 1px rings, separators, and focused state.
Short operational copy written for users who are already in a task.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Use theme tokens and shadcn variant classes. Do not introduce hex, rgb, hsl, Tailwind arbitrary colors, or one-off page palettes.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest uses a token background plus a 1px ring or border.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Do not use viewport-scaled type in product UI.

dos: Do start with existing shadcn/Radix primitives.
Do use token classes such as bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, border-border, text-muted-foreground, and ring-ring/50.
donts: Don't make Synapse look like a marketing landing page inside the app.
Don't use generic AI gradients, decorative glow, emoji headings, over-rounded showpiece cards, or ornamental motion.
Don't introduce hex, rgb, hsl, Tailwind arbitrary colors, custom page palettes, styled components, or one-off CSS modules for ordinary UI.
Don't nest cards inside cards or stack repeated dividers to create hierarchy.
